title: New Business Account Executive
description:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive.

About the job

This position is needed to sell into high value ISV, High Tech, AI Native and Enterprise companies. You will play a key role in further growing Twilio’s Communication business across UK/I/Northern Europe. You will be responsible for sourcing new, high value customers as well as driving the sales process from internal leads to qualifying new prospects and handling deals to closure.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be responsible for net new customer acquisition and driving ACV for a specific set of accounts while maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Work closely with your SDR and SE teams to own, drive and build intelligent outreach campaigns into new prospects
  • Source new leads and drive sustainable pipeline growth each quarter
  • Master creating pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process. Ideally, you also have experience selling communications solutions to a technical and business audience, building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.
  • Are passionate about what you do and you are able to think outside of the box and have extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.
  • Able to balance challenging priorities and handle multiple projects/deals at the same time.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 4+ years of Sales experience and a track record of personally selling and closing complex solutions to ISVs, high tech, AI Native, enterprise and software companies. 
  • Strong experience identifying, mapping and prospecting accounts
  • Proven success in selling complex, technical solutions such as cloud communications platforms, APIs, Conversational AI and/or enterprise software
  • Experience in account management, developing large enterprise clients, and a history of meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • Background in working within a quota-driven environment with proven ability to close high-value deals (e.g., six to seven figures)
  • Expertise in solution-based selling or consultative selling 
  • Strong negotiation and contract management skills, including handling complex deals with long sales cycles.
  • Prospecting and lead generation skills—ability to develop a pipeline through multiple channels, including direct sales, partnerships, and networking.
  • Ability to build and nurture relationships with C-level executives, decision-makers, cross-functional partners and key stakeholders in large enterprises
  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic / environment. 
  • Familiar working with MEDDPICC sales qualification methodology and other Sales methodologies

Desired:

  • Ideally, you also have experience selling both to a business and technical audience
  • Understanding of the CPaaS & Customer Engagement ecosystem and familiarity with:
    • Cloud communications (voice, SMS, chat, video, etc.).
    • Contact centre agent productivity and Conversational AI
    • APIs and integrations for communication services.
    • Telecommunications industry dynamics.
    • Knowledge of enterprise technology architecture and the technical needs of large organizations, including how CPaaS solutions integrate with existing systems.

Location

This role will be remote and based in UK or Ireland.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. 

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Social Content Producer - Inside I35 Contractor
company: Legal Counsel - 12 month FTC at Rightmove Greenhouse
description:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. 

 

Social Video Content Producer (Contractor - Inside IR35) 

Contract duration: Approximately 2-3 months 
Location: London office - Hybrid working (Wednesday and Thursday in the office, with the remaining days remote) 

About the Role 

Rightmove is looking for an experienced Social Video Content Producer to support the delivery of an exciting programme of search-led video content as part of our Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and social search workstream. 

We're looking for someone who combines creative storytelling with hands-on video production expertise, bringing ideas to life through engaging, social-first content.  

Working closely with our Content and Social teams, you'll help develop, film and edit a suite of YouTube videos across key topics, experimenting with different formats and styles to create content that is useful, engaging and discoverable.  

This is a short-term contract opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of the creative process, from initial concepts and scripting through to directing, filming, editing and final delivery.  

What You'll Be Doing 

Content Development & Planning 

  • Develop engaging video concepts from content briefs and agreed topics. 
  • Support scriptwriting and adapt existing content into compelling video narratives. 
  • Collaborate with our Content and Social teams to explore creative approaches, formats and presentation styles. 
  • Plan and coordinate video shoots, including preparing contributors, locations and production environments for filming. 

Video Filming & Production 

  • Lead the end-to-end filming and production of video content, including self-shooting and editing. 
  • Film a range of social-first formats, including face-to-camera, interview-led and podcast-style content – filming in a variety of locations.  
  • Direct and interview on-camera contributors. 
  • Take on some face-to-camera presenting where appropriate. 
  • Capture high-quality footage that can be adapted across different video formats. 

Editing & Post-Production 

  • Edit and produce engaging, high-quality YouTube videos that are appropriately paced and optimised for digital audiences. 
  • Repurpose longer-form content into YouTube Shorts, adapting edits to suit short-form viewing. 
  • Create supporting thumbnails and video packaging to help maximise engagement and discoverability. 
  • Manage the post-production process, incorporating feedback and delivering polished final assets. 
  • Ensure all content is delivered in the required upload-ready formats, including TRV files. 

Collaboration & Delivery 

  • Work closely with our Content and Social teams to ensure content aligns with Rightmove's brand, tone of voice and objectives. 
  • Participate in regular content reviews and planning discussions to maintain progress against agreed deliverables. 
  • Incorporate creative feedback and ensure content meets relevant brand guidelines and compliance requirements. 
  • Collaborate with external agencies where required to support production and delivery. 

What We're Looking For 

We're looking for a creative, hands-on content producer and videographer who understands what makes great social content and has the technical skills to bring it to life.  

You'll ideally bring: 

  • Proven experience producing, filming and editing video content for social and digital platforms, particularly YouTube. 
  • A good eye for detail when looking through the lens and the ability to create high-quality video content, in a range of social-first formats. 
  • Strong understanding of social-first content, including what makes videos engaging, accessible and discoverable. 
  • Experience creating branded content  
  • Experience creating both longer-form YouTube content and short-form formats such as YouTube Shorts. 
  • Ability to develop creative concepts and scripts from initial briefs. 
  • Confidence directing and interviewing contributors, with some experience presenting on camera. 
  • Strong video editing and post-production skills (including some graphics creation), with proficiency in industry-standard editing software, such as Adobe Premiere 
  • Experience creating engaging video thumbnails and understanding how video packaging influences performance. 
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple pieces of content and deliver to agreed timelines. 
  • A collaborative approach, with the confidence to share ideas, take feedback and work with a range of stakeholders. 

An understanding of search-led content, YouTube SEO or emerging social search trends would be particularly valuable. 

  

What You'll Deliver 

Over the course of the engagement, you'll be responsible for delivering: 

  • YouTube videos covering agreed business topics. 
  • Supporting YouTube Shorts edits for each core video. 
  • A mix of creative formats, including face-to-camera, interviews and podcast-style content. 
  • Supporting thumbnails and video packaging. 
  • Final edited assets in agreed, upload-ready formats. 

The programme is expected to be completed by the end of Q4, with opportunities to test different creative approaches and styles throughout the project. 

 

Working Arrangements 

This is a 2–3 month contract engagement, based our Soho, London office. 

We offer a benefit of a hybrid working arrangement, with Wednesday and Thursday as office-based days and the remaining working days remote. The successful individual will be expected to attend the London office and shoot locations to support filming, meetings and collaboration with the wider Content and Social teams. 

You'll be expected to have your own filming and camera equipment, although Rightmove can support with arranging suitable filming locations where needed. 

You'll work closely with our Content team, with additional creative input and oversight from our Social team, participating in regular check-ins and content reviews throughout the project.  

Contract Engagement & Payment Arrangements 

To engage with Rightmove on this contract, the successful candidate will be required to work through one of Rightmove's pre-vetted umbrella companies, which will be responsible for processing payments and payroll administration for the duration of the engagement. Please note the benefits below are only applicable to our directly engaged employees.  

The successful candidate will be required to complete the relevant registration and onboarding process with one of our approved umbrella providers before commencing the engagement. 

Please provide a link to your showreel and/or portfolio in your application. 

Life at Rightmove

Despite our growth, we’ve remained a friendly, supportive place to work, with employee #1 still working here!  We’ve done this by placing the Rightmove Hows at the heart of everything we do. These are the essential values that reflect our culture, and include:

  • We create value…by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.
  • We think bigger…by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations.
  • We care deeply…by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity.
  • We move together…by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive.
  • We make a difference…by focusing on delivering measurable impact.

 

 

We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing   training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with 89% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work, we’re clearly doing something right! 


What we offer

  • Cash plan for dental, optical and physio treatments.
  • Private Medical Insurance, Pension and Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Plan.
  • 27 days holiday plus two (paid) volunteering days a year to give back, and holiday buy schemes.
  • Contributory stakeholder pension.
  • Life assurance at 4x your basic salary to a spouse, family member or other nominated person in your life.
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Paid leave for maternity, paternity, adoption & fertility.
  • Travel Loans, Bike to Work scheme, Rental Deposit Loan.
  • Charitable contributions through Payroll Giving and donation matching.
  • Access deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, gym memberships, cinema discounts and more.
  • We offer hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office. For our roles, such as Field or Home-based positions, different working arrangements apply - full details will be shared during the recruitment process.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Rightmove will never discriminate based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity or sexual orientation. 

At Rightmove, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce leads to better innovation, productivity, and overall success. We are committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their background or identity, to develop and promote a diverse culture that reflects the communities we serve.

By applying, you confirm that you are aged at least 18 or over and that you’ve read and understood our Privacy Policy, which explains how we handle and protect your personal information during the recruitment process.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product team 

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

 

The role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join us in supporting our post-purchase experience and international expansion. Design serves a vital role at Affirm: from building narratives through data to creating products that help people make important financial decisions. As a designer, you are responsible for crafting experiences that build trust, confidence and deliver on our principles of honest, transparent financial products.

We’re at a critical inflection point in Affirm’s journey, with millions of people engaging with our products and new opportunities to expand how they use Affirm every day. We’re also growing globally, reaching new customers in new geographies every day. 

This Product Designer will help shape our post-purchase experiences, as well as building the next new geographies that Affirm will expand into. You can demonstrate a breadth of design experience leveraging your ability to create delightful experiences that simplify our customers’ payment management experience through Affirm as well as contributing to our wider international expansion strategy. You’ll partner well with design leadership, design research, and content design. You’ll work end-to-end, from contributing towards Design and Product vision to delivering class leading design. You are able to work closely with Product and Engineering to tailor unique customer experiences for our merchants & consumers while ensuring cohesion to the core Affirm experience - championing our customers needs no matter where their journey starts.

 

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end design for key initiatives within our UK and international experiences, as well as our post purchase experiences globally, across App and Web. You’ll be driving from discovery through to delivery and iteration—achieving meaningful customer and business outcomes.

  • Own complex flows and ambiguous problem spaces, defining clear problem statements, success metrics, and design direction.

  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and data to make informed trade-offs and deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences.

  • Balance speed and quality, making pragmatic decisions while contributing to a cohesive product experience.

  • Use research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions and continuously improve outcomes.

  • Contribute to design systems and patterns, strengthening consistency and scalability across your area.

  • Facilitate alignment and decision-making, ensuring teams move forward with clarity.

  • Support and mentor other designers, helping raise the quality of work across the team.

 

What we look for

  • Strong Craft & Execution: You consistently deliver polished, thoughtful interaction and visual design with high attention to detail.

  • Product Thinking: You balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints to make sound design decisions and improve end-to-end experiences.

  • Ownership & Initiative: You take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive work forward with minimal oversight.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: You build strong partnerships, communicate clearly, and help teams align on decisions and trade-offs.

  • Data-Informed Decision Making: You use research, experimentation, and analytics to guide your work and iterate toward better outcomes.

  • Team-Level Influence: You’re a trusted design partner within your area, contributing to direction and improving how the team works.

  • Growth & Adaptability: You seek feedback, continuously improve your craft, and leverage modern tools—including AI—to accelerate your workflow.

  • Tools & Experience: Proficiency with modern design and collaboration tools (Figma, G Suite, Notion, etc.).

  • 5+ years of product design experience or equivalent practical experience.

 

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • You’ll design financial products that genuinely help people.

  • You’ll work on high-impact experiences used by millions of customers.

  • You’ll join a team that values craft, collaboration, and thoughtful iteration.

  • You’ll have the opportunity to grow your scope, influence, and leadership over time.

 

This is a remote-first position based in the UK with the option to work from our London office for candidates who prefer an office environment.

 

Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay Grade: L

Equity Grade: UK 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.

GBR base pay range per year: £101,000 - 149,000

Location: Remote UK

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

title: Staff System Software Engineer
description:
About the job

Build the test strategy that protects Graphcore’s system software releases at scale.

As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape integration and system testing across firmware, BMC and Linux device drivers. Your work will help create a high quality gate for system software release packages.

You will design, build, automate and report tests across complex server class systems. You will also develop reusable tools, pipelines and packaging solutions that help teams move faster with confidence.

This role needs deep low level software knowledge and strong system thinking. You will own hard technical areas, guide best practice and stay close to the code.

The team and culture

We’re based across London, Cambridge and Bristol, with projects and discussions that involve all our locations.

Perhaps the best way to get an idea of what we’re all about is to read one of our papers or an article on our blog. If you’re excited to work at the cutting edge of AI supported by new hardware and want to develop your skills in this area, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Generate AI/ML ideas, design experiments, implement them & evaluate results.
  • Prepare, submit & present your work to AI conferences and workshops.
  • Provide technical insight to internal teams by designing experiments and delivering clear, actionable reports.
  • Collaborate with researchers, silicon and software engineers at Graphcore to help define, build and test Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.

 

About you:

Essential:

  •  Master’s, PhD or equivalent experience in a technical discipline (e.g., Maths, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry).
  • Python programming in a modern deep learning framework, e.g. PyTorch or JAX.
  • Familiar with deep learning fundamentals: models, optimisation, evaluation and scaling.
  • Capable of designing, executing and reporting from ML experiments.
  • Lower-level programming for hardware efficiency, e.g. C++/CUDA/Triton.
  • Practical familiarity with hardware capabilities for deep learning – threads, caches, vector & matrix engines, data dependencies, bus widths and throttling.
  • Practical familiarity with software stacks for deep learning – compilation, kernel fusion, XLA/ATen ops, streams, and asynchronous execution

Desirable:

  • Mathematics skills to support the above: calculus, probability theory and linear algebra.
  • Experience submitting papers to international scientific conferences or workshops.

title: Principal Software Engineer - XTM One
description: 🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One , Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite. XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran. This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. You own the technical craft, standards and vision of XTM One, and you carry them into the XTM Foundation, where the engineering principles shared by all products are set for the 60+ engineers at Filigran. 💼 Your Responsibilities Vision & architecture Define and carry the technical vision of XTM One over the long term, with technical and product leadership. Own the platform architecture : agent runtime and orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, data and context layers, APIs, permission model, shared commons. raw.title: Principal Software Engineer - XTM One
raw.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One, Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite.

XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran.

This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. You own the technical craft, standards and vision of XTM One, and you carry them into the XTM Foundation, where the engineering principles shared by all products are set for the 60+ engineers at Filigran.

💼 Your Responsibilities

Vision & architecture

  • Define and carry the technical vision of XTM One over the long term, with technical and product leadership.

  • Own the platform architecture: agent runtime and orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, data and context layers, APIs, permission model, shared commons.

  • Design for SaaS and on premises from day one: multitenancy, isolation, upgrade paths, configuration, operability in customer environments.

  • Arbitrate key decisions on scalability, resilience, security, maintainability and cost, including LLM latency and inference cost.

Standards & quality

  • Define the team's technical principles (architecture patterns, code quality, tooling, CI/CD, testing, development with AI assistants) and get them applied through docs, reviews, pairing and example.

  • Set the bar for observability and reliability of nondeterministic AI workloads: metrics, logs, traces, evaluations, and guardrails that make agent behavior measurable and debuggable in production.

  • Keep the right balance between features, technical debt and innovation.

Integration across products & XTM Foundation

  • Define how OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC and future products integrate with XTM One: contracts, authentication, data exchange, versioning.

  • Be a full member of the XTM Foundation: bring the XTM One perspective in, carry its decisions back, and keep coherence with the other Principal and Staff Engineers.

In the code

  • Write production code, prototype new approaches before the team adopts them, review critical PRs so that feedback teaches, and unblock engineers.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to: VP of Technology

  • Key collaborators: XTM One engineering team and its verticals; XTM Foundation (Principal and Staff Engineers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC); Product leadership; open source contributors.

  • Working model: embedded in the XTM One team, with regular XTM Foundation work.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with technical leadership on complex production platforms.

  • Strong fullstack background, with a backend and architecture focus. You master TypeScript and Python, the core languages of XTM One, and you can take a feature from the data model all the way to the UI.

  • Strong system design: distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, observability.

  • A 360° view of software engineering: product need, design, code and tests, CI/CD, packaging and release, infrastructure and deployment, production operations, monitoring, incident response. A container image or an upgrade path is as familiar to you as an API contract.

  • Built and operated platforms delivered both as SaaS and on premises, including multitenancy and enterprise constraints.

  • Strong AI affinity. You've been building with LLMs by choice for a year or two, with LLM systems in production: agent frameworks, tool calling, MCP, RAG and vector search, evaluation, and the discipline to make them reliable.

  • Technical watch is part of the job. You keep up with your craft deliberately (reading, experimenting, prototyping) and turn what you learn into concrete proposals.

  • You define and carry technical standards: you raise the bar on a team, you don't just follow it.

  • Excellent written communication in English: design docs, ADRs and review comments that others learn from.

  • Autonomous and at ease in a remote, asynchronous culture; you drive problems to resolution and enable others instead of becoming a bottleneck.

  • Bonus: cybersecurity domain knowledge (CTI, CTEM, MITRE ATT&CK, STIX/TAXII); extensible plugin or tool ecosystems; open source contributions or maintainership.

🛡️ About XTM One

XTM One is Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense. It is dedicated to creating and running cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatching their intelligence across the products of the XTM Suite.

Every product of the XTM Suite is connected to XTM One to leverage AI agents for a more proactive platform that is easier to use. Within XTM One, agents can use and correlate data across products to make the most meaningful assessments and take the most relevant actions. XTM One also hosts shared commons such as unified authentication and consolidated datasets and configuration.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

Fix what penetration tests and security researchers report to us, run responsible disclosure, and keep the technical evidence for our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls current, working with our information security lead. title: IT Manager (m/f/d)
description: Über Buena Buena, finanziert von Google Ventures, macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Wir übernehmen Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie digital weiter. Mit jeder Übernahme wachsen auch unsere Anforderungen an die IT: Neue Mitarbeitende, Geräte und Standorte sollen zuverlässig zusammenarbeiten. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die unsere IT übernimmt und mit unserem Wachstum weiterentwickelt. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest zunächst die IT unserer Berliner Zentrale. Du sorgst dafür, dass Mitarbeitende arbeitsfähig sind, Zugänge sicher verwaltet werden und Geräte sowie Netzwerk zuverlässig funktionieren. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du Standards und Abläufe, die auch bei der nächsten Hausverwaltung funktionieren. Mittelfristig begleitest du die IT-Integration unserer Tochterunternehmen und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem externen IT-Partner zusammen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Product. Mit wachsender Verantwortung kannst du dich in die Rolle des Head of IT für die Buena-Gruppe entwickeln. Was du bei uns machst Du hältst unsere IT in Berlin am Laufen. Du unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort, löst technische Probleme und betreust unser UniFi-Netzwerk. Du verantwortest Google Workspace. Du verwaltest Nutzer, Gruppen, Berechtigungen, Shared Drives und Lizenzen und setzt verlässliche Sicherheitseinstellungen um. Du organisierst Ein- und Austritte. Neue Mitarbeitende starten mit eingerichteten Konten und Geräten. Beim Austritt kümmerst du dich um Zugriffsrechte, Datensicherung und die Rücknahme der Hardware. Du verwaltest unsere Geräte. Du betreust Laptops und Mobilgeräte mit NinjaOne sowie Apple-Geräte über den Apple Business Manager und die angebundene Geräteverwaltung. Du verbesserst wiederkehrende Abläufe. Du erkennst unnötige Handarbeit, automatisierst sinnvolle Schritte und dokumentierst Prozesse so, dass andere damit arbeiten können. Du begleitest neue Standorte. Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über deren IT, planst notwendige Anpassungen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Partner um. Dafür reist du gelegentlich zu unseren Hausverwaltungen. Was du mitbringst Du hast mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Systemadministration und kannst eine IT-Umgebung eigenständig betreuen. Du kennst Google Workspace gut und hast Erfahrung mit Geräteverwaltung, beispielsweise NinjaOne, Jamf oder Intune. Du bist mit macOS, iOS und dem Apple Business Manager vertraut und verfügst über solide Netzwerkgrundkenntnisse, idealerweise mit UniFi. Du hast bereits einen IT-Prozess verbessert, eine neue Lösung eingeführt oder eine Systemumstellung begleitet und kannst deinen eigenen Beitrag erklären. Du gehst Fehlern systematisch auf den Grund und kannst entscheiden, was zuerst gelöst werden muss. Du erklärst technische Themen verständlich und arbeitest verbindlich mit Mitarbeitenden und externen Dienstleistern zusammen. Du möchtest vor Ort in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten, bist zu gelegentlichen Reisen bereit und sprichst sehr gut Deutsch sowie gut Englisch. Eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist hilfreich. Einschlägige Praxiserfahrung zählt genauso. Führungserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung; du solltest Lust haben, mit der Aufgabe zu wachsen und zunehmend übergreifende Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Was du bei uns bekommst Verantwortung für einen Bereich, den du aktiv mitgestaltest. Die Perspektive, mit Buena in eine Head-of-IT-Rolle hineinzuwachsen. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of Integration und kurze Entscheidungswege. Attraktives Gehalt und 500 € „Close-to-Office“-Bonus. MacBook und Studio Display. 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss. Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest. Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro. title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support
description: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. Wie ben jij Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen. Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten. Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn. Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers. Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat. Wat ga je doen Wat breng je mee? Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen. • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst; Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen; • Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn; • Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee; • Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren; • Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn; • Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving; • Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is; • Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré. Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening. Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is? We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen. • ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support; • prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen; • vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten; • richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening; • sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid; • onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen; • afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams; • samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren; • signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren; • richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur; • kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen; • organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives. Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan. Wat bieden wij Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie. Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf. Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis. Wie wij zijn Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy. Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner. Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken. Over Ockto

Ockto is een Nederlandse SaaS-scale-up die organisaties helpt om complexe financiële en administratieve processen slimmer, sneller en volledig digitaal te maken. Met ons platform kunnen consumenten veilig en eenvoudig hun persoonlijke en financiële gegevens delen, rechtstreeks vanuit betrouwbare bronnen.

Maar Ockto gaat verder dan alleen het verzamelen en delen van gegevens. We combineren, structureren, valideren en verrijken data tot complete, betrouwbare en direct bruikbare datasets. Hiermee helpen we organisaties om processen verder te automatiseren, betere beslissingen te nemen en aanvragen zoveel mogelijk volledig automatisch af te handelen (Straight Through Processing).

Onze technologie wordt ingezet door een groot aantal gerenommeerde partijen binnen Nederland, waaronder banken, leasemaatschappijen, hypotheekverstrekkers, online webshops, en overheidsinstellingen. Zo verminderen we handmatige werkzaamheden, versnellen we doorlooptijden en verbeteren we de klantbeleving, met privacy, veiligheid en compliance als belangrijke uitgangspunten.

Met meer dan 100 aangesloten organisaties bouwen we dagelijks verder aan een toekomst waarin betrouwbare data de basis vormt voor slimme, efficiënte en volledig digitale dienstverlening.

De rol

We zijn op zoek naar een Senior Business Consultant die organisaties helpt complexe business vraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en nieuwe zakelijke kansen.

In deze rol combineer je strategisch inzicht met een commerciële blik. Du berichtest an unserem VP Finance Operation und arbeitest eng mit unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO, sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass gruppenweite Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Projekte erfolgreich umgesetzt werden. Dabei entwickelst du unsere Finance-Organisation gezielt weiter: Du koordinierst Finance-Projekte, begleitest die Integration neuer Gesellschaften, harmonisierst Prozesse und schaffst die Grundlage für eine skalierbare Finance-Plattform. Dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung! Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin. Deine Aufgaben: Finance Integration & Post-Merger-Integration Die Finanzintegration neuer Tochtergesellschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich und begleitest sie von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung. Neue Gesellschaften unterstützt Du bei der Einführung und Umsetzung gruppenweiter Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Systeme. Integrationsmaßnahmen und relevante Meilensteine verfolgst Du strukturiert nach und stellst einen transparenten Projektfortschritt sicher. Abhängigkeiten und Handlungsbedarfe identifizierst Du frühzeitig und steuerst notwendige Eskalationen mit den relevanten Stakeholdern. Finance Transformation & Standardisierung Gruppenweite Finance-Projekte und Transformationsinitiativen steuerst und koordinierst Du über verschiedene Gesellschaften und Fachbereiche hinweg. Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Reporting-Strukturen entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit den relevanten Teams kontinuierlich weiter. Optimierungs- und Standardisierungspotenziale innerhalb unserer Finance-Landschaft identifizierst Du und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Die Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Finance-Strukturen und Systeme begleitest Du mit Blick auf die Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe. Stakeholder- & Projektmanagement Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem VP Finance Operations, Director FP&A, CFO sowie den Geschäftsführungen und Finance-Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen. Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst Du die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Group Accounting, Group Controlling / FP&A und den lokalen Gesellschaften. Unterschiedliche interne und externe Stakeholder bringst Du zusammen und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Abstimmungen und nächste Schritte. Relevante Projektfortschritte, Entscheidungsbedarfe und Risiken bereitest Du transparent auf und kommunizierst diese an die beteiligten Stakeholder. Deine Startvoraussetzungen: Das bringst Du mit: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Finance-Umfeld mit fundiertem Verständnis von Accounting- und/oder Controlling-Prozessen bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage. Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie im souveränen Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern bringst Du mit. Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv voranzutreiben und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzubringen, zeichnen Dich aus. Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise runden Dein Profil ab. Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein: Erfahrung in den Bereichen Finance Transformation, Finance Excellence, CFO Office oder Consulting wäre von Vorteil. Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) sind wünschenswert. Erfahrung in einem PE-finanzierten, Multi-Entity-, Buy-&-Build- oder vergleichbaren Wachstumsumfeld wäre ein Plus. Erfahrung bei der Standardisierung, Digitalisierung oder Skalierung von Finance-Prozessen und -Systemen würde Dir den Einstieg erleichtern. Unsere Benefits: Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit einem Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“. Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre. Direkte Nähe zur Finance-Führung und zum Business: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem VP Finance, dem CFO sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und unterstützt aktiv den Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform: Du gestaltest Prozesse, Strukturen und strategische Initiativen in einer krisensicheren, rasant wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv mit und erhältst Einblicke in die Umsetzung einer Roll-up-Strategie – unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus. Einblicke in die Finance-Transformation einer PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe: Von der Integration neuer Gesellschaften über die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Systemen bis hin zu Reporting-, Governance- und Skalierungsprojekten wirkst du an zentralen Finance-Initiativen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie mit. Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Kurzes Telefonat mit dem Group Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe. Interview mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner*innen aus dem Group Finance Operations Team. Persönliches Kennenlernen mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner*innen aus dem Group Finance Operations Team. Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Dir gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung! title: Senior Software Engineer - Exchange
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About Fanatics Markets:

Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow - from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.

Overview:

Fanatics recently acquired a CFTC-registered Designated Contract Market and Derivatives Clearing Organisation, giving Fanatics Markets its own fully regulated exchange and clearinghouse infrastructure. We are now building the engineering team that will run it.

This Senior Software Engineer (Backend) role sits at the heart of that build. You will have significant ownership over the core exchange platform, working on the systems that power order processing, market data distribution, trade lifecycle management and regulatory reporting for a CFTC-regulated exchange. The engineering challenges are those of any serious regulated trading environment, high-availability, low-latency, mission-critical infrastructure, but built for a consumer audience with the reach and distribution of Fanatics behind it.

You will be joining a team modernising an existing Java codebase and building new services in Java, working alongside engineers with deep backgrounds in regulated financial infrastructure. You will be joining a team with a clear ambition: to bring this platform to the bleeding edge of financial infrastructure. This is not a clean slate but the technical ambition is real, and engineers who join now will have a level of architectural influence and ownership that is hard to find anywhere else.

We are pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have gone beyond experimentation and who actively use Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of high-performance, fault-tolerant distributed backend services supporting the FMX exchange platform.
  • Own services and features end-to-end: spec writing, implementation, instrumentation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration based on metrics.
  • Work within and help modernise the existing Java codebase while contributing to new service development in Java and potentially Kotlin.
  • Contribute to the architecture for order processing, market data distribution, and trade lifecycle management on a CFTC-regulated exchange.
  • Build and maintain reliable daily reporting pipelines, ensuring data integrity and full audit trails across all trading activity.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotations, contribute to SLO definition, alerting strategy, and incident response for mission-critical trading infrastructure.
  • Model and manage data for contracts, orders, positions, and settlements with an emphasis on correctness, integrity, and regulatory auditability.
  • Collaborate with the DevOps/Platform team to ensure services are observable, scalable, and compliant with MNPI and insider trading restrictions.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews, raising the bar on code quality, readability, security, and maintainability.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate development velocity while maintaining high standards for security, correctness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Establish and document team standards for AI usage, prompt patterns, code review checklists, and validation strategies.
  • Contribute to a fast-paced environment, unblocking others and taking initiative where processes are still being defined.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience building highly scalable, high-performance backend applications or distributed systems.
  • Background in regulated exchange or financial infrastructure strongly preferred, brokerage, futures or derivatives exchanges (e.g. CBOE, CME, ICE), market makers, or hedge funds with relevant trading infrastructure experience, or similar CFTC/SEC-regulated environments.
  • Strong production experience with Java; Kotlin experience a plus.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, PubSub, or similar) in a financial or high-throughput context.
  • Strong understanding of data integrity and transaction management in PostgreSQL or equivalent RDBMS, including financial-grade data modelling.
  • Solid grasp of software design principles (SOLID, DRY) and testing methodologies (unit, integration, end-to-end).
  • Familiarity with CFTC compliance requirements, MNPI handling, and audit trail obligations in a regulated trading environment.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for backend services.
  • Production reliability experience: monitoring, logging, alerting, on-call, and SLO definition.

On our teams, you will be backed by leaders with a passion for our business. This is a place where your ideas can Do Great Things.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business.

Adventure starts here. Here you will be a part of a team that encourages you to master your craft, ask tomorrow’s questions today, and chart your path. Our Associates focus on client impact with curiosity and a feeling of relentless commitment.

About the role and what you will be doing:

This is an exciting opportunity to join a small, friendly, Agile-based, team working on some of the hottest public cloud technologies.  

The Public Cloud Product Engineering team works closely with our Product Management team to bring to life standard services and solutions that can be repeatedly sold to multiple managed service customers.  

Using your strong background in automation, engineering, and best practice you will also play a major role in defining and evolving our public cloud standards, implementing new tools, onboarding new AWS and GCP services, and act as an SME supporting other teams. 

The successful candidate will be someone who can demonstrate a genuine desire and passion for public cloud; automation; keeping it simple, supportable, and scalable; with proven ability to deliver pragmatic workable solutions on time. 

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the lead engineer on Product Engineering epics and stories.
  • Develop (“operationalize”) new repeatable Ensono public cloud services and solutions.
  • Define and evolve public cloud technical standards to ensure repeatability, supportability, scalability, and security.
  • Make recommendations on technical stack including research, assessments, bake-offs, and proof of concepts.
  • Assess and onboard new AWS and GCP services in line with the Product roadmap.
  • Drive the deployment of automated infrastructure and systems using IAC, config management and scripting.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and advice to pre-sales architects on our technical standards.
  • Act as a final line of escalation and assistance for the cloud operations team for major problems.
  • Proactively keep up to date on public cloud services and related technology. 

Desired Skills and Experience

  • 8+ years’ experience in supporting highly customer-focused mission critical environments (e.g., high profile web or enterprise infrastructure) essential.
  • 5+ years’ experience of architecting, engineering, or supporting public cloud solutions on AWS or GCP.
  • Sound knowledge of AWS or GCP best practice, security considerations, and architectural design patterns.
  • Experience of implementing and supporting public-cloud based workloads and services.
  • Hold multiple current AWS or Google Cloud Certifications (or be able to demonstrate equivalent level of knowledge).
  • Experience of building solutions using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud formation) 
  • Experience of config management systems (e.g., Ansible).
  • Excellent Linux O/S knowledge and experience (RHCE or equivalent level of knowledge).
  • Scripting ability in Python, Perl, or Bash.
  • Experience of using Git for version control.
  • Experience of the AWS or GCP CLI and scripting against it.
  • Experience of working with, designing, deploying, or supporting containerized environments (ECS/EKS/Kubernetes/Docker) is useful, but not essential.
  • Experience of Jenkins or other CI/CD pipeline technology useful.
  • Able to leverage AI tools to improve productivity and quality (e.g. Copilot/Claude/Kiro)
  • Good knowledge of TCP/IP.
  • A degree in a computing-related discipline preferred or equivalent ability and knowledge.
  • Experience working in ITIL and Agile environments beneficial.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to share knowledge via clear and concise documentation, and demos/presentations.
  • Able to implement supportable solutions and make the complex simple.
  • Able to work in an organized and efficient manner without close supervision  
  • Must be self-motivated, a self-starter and possess a good working attitude.
  • Desire to continually grow, develop and improve.
  • Able to perform as a role model within the team. 

Benefits: 

We believe that great work deserves great rewards. In return for your ideas, commitment and ambition, we’ll give you a very competitive base salary and a range of benefits as soon as you join. On top of your highly competitive base salary, we offer: 

 

  • Highly competitive salary
  • Prestigious sales and broader team recognition with Annual Presidents Club

Idealerweise hast du schon Social-Media-Kanäle betreut oder eigenen Content veröffentlicht – für ein Unternehmen, eine Agentur oder deinen eigenen Kanal. Du hast Creator-Energie. Du wartest nicht auf Briefings, sondern kommst mit Ideen. Kamera ist kein Problem. Du hast keine Scheu, auch mal selbst vor der Linse zu stehen – musst aber nicht. Du übernimmst Ownership. Du hältst Deadlines, denkst mit und gehst einen Schritt weiter, statt auf Antworten zu warten. Du studierst. Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben und kannst ab dem 15. Januar 2027 bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche bei uns arbeiten. Du möchtest etwas aufbauen. Nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten. Was wir bieten: Build Something Big: 2027 wird Miss Germany 100 Jahre alt. Du gestaltest unseren Short-Form-Auftritt in genau dieser Phase aktiv mit. Impact Driven: Wir unterstützen mit Herzblut Frauen bei ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und tragen zu einer vielfältigeren und gleichberechtigteren Gesellschaft bei. Creator Playground: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, Formate auszuprobieren und gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden, was Menschen wirklich bewegt. Ownership statt Micromanagement: Viel Vertrauen, kurze Entscheidungswege und echte Verantwortung statt endloser Abstimmungsschleifen. Base Köln/Düsseldorf: Du arbeitest von Köln oder Düsseldorf aus – remote oder im Co-Working-Space. Ein festes Muster gibt es nicht, wir schauen gemeinsam, was passt. Work with Inspiring People: Du arbeitest mit beeindruckenden Frauen, spannenden Persönlichkeiten, Partnern und einem Netzwerk, das weit über Miss Germany hinausgeht. Learn Fast: Schnitt, Storytelling, Plattformen, Community, Personal Brands und Medien – du wirst in kurzer Zeit unglaublich viel lernen. Möchtest du in deinem Praktikum mehr bewegen als nur Kaffee zu kochen oder Akten zu sortieren? Bist du leidenschaftlich an Umweltschutz und Nachhaltigkeit interessiert und möchtest aktiv zum Schutz unseres Planeten beitragen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Mit einem Praktikum bei Project Wings kannst du Teil eines motivierten Teams sein, in dem du deine Ideen und Fähigkeiten umfassend einbringen kannst. Bei uns findest du ein freundliches und respektvolles Arbeitsumfeld, mit flachen Hierarchien sowie offener Kommunikation. Mit deiner Arbeit erhältst du die Möglichkeit, hinter die Kulissen einer modernen NGO zu blicken, einen echten Einfluss auf unsere Projekte zu haben und deine persönlichen Stärken und Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln. Wir suchen Praktikant:innen, die teamfähig und neugierig sind und Interesse daran haben, verschiedene Projekte und Arbeitsbereiche im Bereich Nachhaltigkeit kennenzulernen.

Deine Aufgaben bei uns sind vielfältig:

  • Mediengestaltung: Videos, Reels, Infografiken, Animationen, Präsentationen

  • Design: Grafiken, Layouts, Templates für Social Media, Website & Print

  • Marketing: Social Media Kampagnen, Community-Management, Influencer- & Kooperationskampagnen, Website-Pflege, Presse- & Öffentlichkeitsarbeit, Events

  • Vertrieb: Recherche und Kontaktaufnahme zu Partner:innen & Förder:innen und Mitarbeit an Konzepten (z. B. Wings Coin, Wings Dining), Antragstellung für Förderungen

  • Webseite: Pflege, Verbesserung, Änderung und Umgestaltung

good to know: Da wir ein kleines Team sind, packt jede*r überall an, wo Hilfe gebraucht wird. So bekommst du rundum einen Einblick in die Arbeit einer NGO. Wir bieten dir die Chance für ein abwechslungsreiches Praktikum, in dem du alle Bereiche kennenlernst und mitwirken kannst. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt jedoch in dem Bereich, der dich am meisten interessiert – sei es Design, Vertrieb, Mediengestaltung oder Marketing. Andere Aufgabenbereiche sind beispielsweise:

  • Bildungsarbeit

  • Backoffice

  • Spendenmanagement

Was Du mitbringst:

  • Kreativität und Interesse an Design und Content Creation

  • Bereitschaft, sich in verschiedene Themen in kurzer Zeit einzuarbeiten

  • Empathie, Teamfähigkeit, Sensibilität und offene Kommunikation

  • Eigeninitiative in der Gestaltung, Weiterentwicklung und Neuentwicklung von Konzepten im Marketingbereich

  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

  • Engagement und Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz

Nice to have:

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Canva

  • Erste Erfahrung in Social Media Marketing und Content Creation

  • Kenntnisse in Video-Schnitt und Bildbearbeitung

  • Grundkenntnisse im Projektmanagement oder Vertrieb

  • Studium/ Ausbildung in Marketing, Kommunikation-/ Mediendesign, Medien, BWL

  • Führerschein

Wenn Dein Bereich in der Aufzählung fehlt – kein Problem! Ob du gerade ein Gap Year machst, frisch von der Schule kommst, dich im Studium oder einer Ausbildung befindest, bereits Berufserfahrung gesammelt hast oder aus einem ganz anderen Fachbereich kommst – bei uns zählt vor allem deine Motivation. Unabhängig von Vorwissen oder Studienrichtung: Wer Lust hat, sich mit Ideen und Engagement für die Umwelt einzusetzen, ist bei uns genau richtig. Wir bieten Dir eine offene Arbeitsatmosphäre, in der du dich einbringen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas bewegen kannst.

Was wir dir bieten:

  • flexibler Arbeitsplan (teile Deine Stunden selbst ein - von Montag bis Sonntag frei wählbar)

  • motiviertes und engagiertes Team, das dir stets mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht

  • Verantwortung für Deinen eigenen Bereich

  • Zusammenarbeit mit bis zu vier weiteren Praktikant:innen, von deren Erfahrungen du profitierst

  • ein sehr vielseitiges Praktikum, da du die Möglichkeit hast, in alle Bereiche rein zu schauen

  • Snacks für zwischendurch und - wer möchte - verschiedene gemeinsame Aktivitäten (wie Yoga oder Spieleabende)

  • Ein Kicker und eine Dartscheibe im Büro für Spaß in den Pausen mit anderen Praktikant:innen ;)

  • Kaffee mit ganz viel Liebe und hohem Genussfaktor ❤︎

Start jederzeit möglich, Mindestdauer 2 Monate bis 1 Jahr

Help people feel at home, beyond the booking.

Booking a place is only the beginning. Moving to a new country means navigating unfamiliar processes, managing payments, and building a relationship with a landlord—all while settling into a new life. We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Post Booking experience, with a strong focus on our mobile app. You will shape how tenants and landlords use HousingAnywhere throughout a tenancy: from preparing for move-in and managing payments to getting support and extending a stay.

You'll bring strong mobile app design experience and product thinking to make these everyday interactions feel simple, intuitive, and reliable—helping turn HousingAnywhere into a trusted companion throughout the rental journey.

  • Shape the long-term vision for the journey beyond the booking, making HousingAnywhere a trusted part of everyday renting.
  • Design experiences that help tenants and landlords prepare for move-in, manage payments, communicate clearly, and navigate issues with confidence.
  • Explore how we can provide ongoing value throughout a tenancy, including renewals and longer stays.
  • Lead projects from early discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Use qualitative research, behavioural data, and experimentation to make decisions, not opinions.
  • Define success, measure impact, and continuously improve your solutions—connecting customer trust and satisfaction with adoption, retention, and business value.
  • Raise the quality bar across the design team through thoughtful critique and craft.
  • Contribute to our design principles, design system, and the way we build the product.

 

Your team

Collaborate deeply. Design with absolute purpose.

We move fast, we think ahead, and we focus on what our audience truly needs. You'll have the freedom to influence your team's strategy in an environment that values:

  • Elegant interaction design and meaningful micro-interactions

  • Experience running discovery and validating ideas.

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers and product managers.
  • A portfolio showing not only what you designed – but why.

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!

  • Complete coverage for commuting.
  • Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.
  • Gym membership discount with GoVital or OneFit.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.
  • Variable pension scheme.
  • Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).
  • Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. 
  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.
