raw.jobDescription:
Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.

To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build and scale Mattermost's core web platform for teams operating in defense and critical infrastructure sectors. You will contribute across our Go backend and React/TypeScript web frontend, building features that hold up under strict security, compliance, and reliability requirements.

Our engineering culture is AI-forward. We expect engineers to work fluently with AI coding agents such as Claude Code day-to-day — for scaffolding, refactors, code review, and test generation — and treat that as core craft rather than a shortcut. We would rather hire smart people who get stuff done than chase an exact tech-stack match. If you have a track record of shipping and owning complex software end-to-end, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do

  • Architect and build full-stack features optimized for scalability and performance across Go, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Redis
  • Leverage AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor as a core part of your daily workflow while retaining full accountability for correctness, security, and design decisions
  • Develop internal tooling and testing infrastructure to speed up the team's delivery, including agentic workflows and skills that make AI tooling more effective for the broader team
  • Own testing strategy across frontend and backend code you ship
  • Design and consume REST and WebSocket APIs with solid networking fundamentals
  • Maintain the security and compliance standards required by our government and enterprise clients
  • Contribute to Mattermost's open-source codebase

What We Are Looking For

Required:

  • Strong full-stack development experience in Go and React, or a comparable stack
  • Experience designing and consuming REST and WebSocket APIs with solid networking fundamentals
  • Relational database experience including PostgreSQL, schema design, and query optimization
  • Hands-on daily fluency directing AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot for scaffolding, refactors, code review, and test generation — with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to take the wheel yourself
  • Bias toward shipping and owning complex software end-to-end without close supervision

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with distributed systems or high-availability service architecture
  • Familiarity with enterprise or regulated-environment security requirements
  • Background in defense, intelligence, or critical infrastructure products
  • Open-source contributions
  • Experience working on distributed or remote-first teams
  • Experience building tools, skills, or workflows on top of AI coding agents including MCP servers, agent skills, or CI-integrated agents

How Success Is Measured

  • First 90 Days: Shipping full-stack features on the core platform using an AI-forward agentic development workflow and owning testing strategy across the code you ship.

Why Mattermost

  • Mission-driven work: Your contributions directly support the organizations and missions that depend on secure, reliable collaboration including the U.S. Department of War and critical infrastructure operators worldwide
  • Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere with a globally distributed, high-trust team built for autonomy and ownership
  • AI-forward environment: We actively adopt and build AI-enabled workflows. Agentic development is core craft here, not a novelty
  • End-to-end ownership: Ship and own complex software across the full stack with real accountability for what you build
  • Open source at the core: Be part of a vibrant developer community shaping the future of secure collaboration

Compensation

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

Target Salary Range: CAD $162,591–$195,000

Canada Eligibility & Compliance

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada without current or future sponsorship.

This role may require obtaining and maintaining a government security clearance or equivalent designation (such as Reliability Status or Secret clearance under Canada's Controlled Goods Program), depending on customer engagement. Candidates must meet eligibility requirements to be considered.

Given Mattermost's work with U.S. defense and government customers, some positions may also require compliance with U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR, which can apply to non-U.S. based employees working on covered technical data. For more information, visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.

We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.

Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.

If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to assist.

Because our team is lean, you'll have the opportunity to own meaningful work, contribute to technical direction, and jump into new challenges as projects evolve. This isn't a role for someone who simply executes tickets — we're looking for a collaborative problem solver who brings ideas, challenges assumptions, and helps shape the products they build.

You'll work across a wide variety of client engagements, from marketing websites and ecommerce platforms to digital products and emerging experiences. Because our team is lean, you'll have the opportunity to own meaningful work, contribute to technical direction, and jump into new challenges as projects evolve.

If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, thrive in a collaborative agency environment, and like building products where engineering has a seat at the table, we'd love to hear from you.

    • Work From Home and Wellbeing monthly stipend

    Compensation

    Additional Information

raw.jobDescription:
About Dune

Dune is on a mission to make crypto data accessible. We’re a collaborative multi-chain analytics platform used by thousands of developers, analysts, & investors to understand the on-chain world and the frontiers of finance. We’re a team of ~60 employees, working together across Europe and eastern US timezones 🌍️. We believe in our mission, and in building a powerful, open product that allows individuals and communities to do deep research into important ecosystems like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and many more.

We’re backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that allowed us to double down on our mission. We’re using the funds to educate, reward and empower a new generation of onchain analysts aka Wizards 🧙‍♀️

If you want to have one of the highest impact jobs on the planet, come join our wonderful team of Galaxy brains.

Learn more about us:

Dune's Vision

Values and working at Dune

About the role

Data Foundation owns how blockchain data enters Dune, how it is represented and how it’s delivered externally. This is a role that involves thinking about large distributed data systems, recognising traditional scaling patterns and software lifecycle pitfalls, and is ideal for anyone passionate about those topics.

You will be the engineer we hand ambiguous product requirements to, and will be comfortable coming back with a design, a sequence, and a set of tasks the team can pick up as well as building the hardest parts yourself.

In this role you will

  • Turn product requirements into technical requirements: model the domain, define the interfaces and the workflows, and navigate trade-offs

  • Break large problems into work other engineers can own, and sequence it so we ship something useful early

  • Drive high-impact architectural decisions across the data platform, and own components end to end from design through production

  • Work across our stack, mainly Go, Kotlin, Rust and Python where they fit, choosing the right tool rather than the familiar one

  • Design for correctness and performance under real volume: large-scale ingestion, distributed processing, and data lake storage

  • Raise the bar on design reviews, testing, and how the team breaks work down

  • Mentor engineers by example, in a fully distributed team

You might be a great fit if

  • You are a strong generalist with real computer science fundamentals, and you use them to adapt quickly to new technologies and problem spaces

  • You reason from first principles: you make assumptions explicit, identify the constraints and invariants that matter, and derive the solution rather than reaching for a familiar pattern.

  • You use computer science fundamentals as practical tools. You have designed and shipped distributed data systems, making their contracts, state transitions, invariants, and failure modes explicit. You know their fault models and scaling weaknesses

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity : you will talk to product, to customers, and to the team, then commit to a scope and defend it

  • You use AI tools well enough that they have changed how you work, you understand their failure modes and dislike ai-slop.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and get the best out of a distributed team

Not required, but a plus

  • Experience with data lakes and formats such as Parquet, Iceberg or Deltalog

  • Experience at a company where the data is the product

Perks & Benefits

  • A competitive salary and equity package 🚀. Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

  • Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

  • 5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) 🏖

  • A fully remote-first approach 🧑‍💻 within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day

  • Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

  • Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard 🩺

  • We believe in paid parental leave 👶 to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

  • Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany 🇮🇹 Berlin 🇩🇪 Austria 🇦🇹 and Athens 🇬🇷).

  • On top of this 👆each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

  • An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

  • Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

  • And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️😎

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

raw.jobDescription:
Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you’re driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human, and powered by cutting-edge technology, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Be Up To:

  • Implementing Core services for the platform in .NET 10 that runs in Docker containers;
  • Developing features from DB to the APIs;
  • Ensuring the platform remains scalable and the codebase remains maintainable;
  • Proactively monitoring the services in production and spotting potential issues;
  • Care about the quality of produced code by covering it with unit and e2e tests;
  • You will be a part of an exciting, open, and agile team, where your voice matters and has a company-wide impact.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience;
  • You bring at least 5 years of experience working in software engineering with relevant programming experience;
  • Proficient in .NET backend development, including technologies such as Kafka (or equivalents), AWS, Docker, ECS/Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code) to accelerate development, troubleshoot code, and generate documentation;
  • A growth mindset toward continuously exploring new AI technologies that can positively impact our engineering culture and delivery pipeline.
  • Nice to have: Experience applying Kafka for real-time processing, leveraging AWS/Docker for DevOps workflows, or performing PostgreSQL optimizations.
  • You know how to break down large epics into smaller issues;
  • You worked with the concepts of IaaS/ PaaS/ SaaS;
  • You worked extensively with microservices-based architecture and used asynchronous message-based communication;
  • You communicate fluently in English; German and any other languages are always welcomed;

What We Offer

Culture & Growth

  • A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You’ll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
  • Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you’ll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

  • Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
  • Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
  • Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role, it’s about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Headquarters: US URL: https://knack.com Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote) If US-Based: This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval. International Contractor: This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone. Role Overview Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities. We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation. About Knack Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code. Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations. To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact. Key Responsibilities Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions. Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it. Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent. Make AWS and Claude work together Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes. Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do. Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability. Implement security controls with our security lead Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets. Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment. Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk. Support compliance and audits Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups. Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change. Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling. Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts. Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them. Keep systems patched and current Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals. Operate and scale databases and customer environments Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms. Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support. Resolve escalations and automate repeat work Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering. Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces. Participate in on-call Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat. Qualifications Experience 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number. Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation. A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally. Technical depth Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS. Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is. Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation. Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts. Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production. Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals. Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch. How you work with AI Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation. Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments. A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling. Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers. Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows. Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild. Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling). Kubernetes/EKS experience. Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats. Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knack-cloud-engineer-1

  • Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do.
  • Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability.

Implement security controls with our security lead

  • Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets.
  • Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment.
  • Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk.

Support compliance and audits

  • Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups.
  • Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change.
  • Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling.

Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks

  • Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts.
  • Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them.

Keep systems patched and current

  • Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals.

Operate and scale databases and customer environments

  • Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms.
  • Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support.

Resolve escalations and automate repeat work

  • Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering.
  • Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces.

Participate in on-call

  • Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number.
  • Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally.

Technical depth

  • Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS.
  • Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts.
  • Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production.
  • Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals.
  • Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch.

How you work with AI

  • Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship.

  • Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments.
  • A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling.

  • Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild.

  • Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats.

raw.jobDescription:
About Neuroscale AI

Neuroscale AI is building a next-generation AI recruiting and talent intelligence platform that helps organizations turn hiring into a measurable, repeatable, and intelligent science. Our ARBI platform supports sourcing, screening, evaluation, sequencing, scheduling, recruiter workflow automation, and explainable candidate assessment for commercial enterprises, public-sector agencies, higher education, staffing organizations, and workforce-development teams.

Neuroscale is also building Athena, an AI-powered career readiness and candidate-assistance experience that helps users improve resumes, prepare for interviews, receive rubric-based feedback, and navigate the job search process with personalized AI support.

We are a fast-moving startup operating at the intersection of GenAI, HR technology, recruiting operations, career services, workflow automation, and enterprise AI deployment. As ARBI and Athena scale across customers, we need a senior quality leader who can make product quality measurable, automated, auditable, and trusted.

Role Overview

We are hiring a Senior QA Engineer / Quality Engineering Lead to own quality assurance, testing strategy, product validation, and release readiness across ARBI and Athena. This is a hands-on senior role for someone who can test deeply, build automated quality systems, validate AI workflows, improve developer quality practices, and become the central authority for product quality.

This role is not limited to executing test cases. You will audit the current QA landscape, define the testing strategy, build regression and automation frameworks, validate AI behavior, pressure-test edge cases, and create the release confidence needed for a rapidly evolving SaaS platform.

You will work closely with engineering, product, design, customer success, and founders to make sure new features, bug fixes, experiments, integrations, data workflows, and AI-driven experiences ship with clarity, reliability, auditability, accessibility, and user trust.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

1) Build the Quality Strategy and QA Operating System

• Perform a deep audit of the current QA setup across ARBI, Athena, frontend flows, backend services, APIs, data workflows, integrations, AI pipelines, and release processes.

• Define a company-wide QA strategy across short-term stabilization, mid-term automation, and long-term quality engineering maturity.

• Design a scalable test architecture using test pyramid principles, shift-left testing, smoke testing, regression testing, release gates, exploratory testing, and risk-based coverage.

• Define clear QA responsibilities between developers, QA, product, design, customer success, and release owners.

• Establish a practical quality operating rhythm: test plans, release checklists, defect triage, severity definitions, sign-off workflows, and quality metrics.

2) Own Product QA for ARBI and Athena

• Validate implementation against requirements, designs, copy, acceptance criteria, user stories, and customer-specific workflows.

• Test UI, UX, business logic, responsiveness, edge cases, error states, empty states, loading states, accessibility, and validation messages.

• Perform exploratory, smoke, regression, and release-candidate testing before launches.

• Validate recruiter workflows including candidate search, matching, scoring, resume parsing, outreach sequencing, scheduling, recruiter dashboards, candidate profiles, and ATS/CRM-style workflows.

• Validate Athena workflows including resume support, interview preparation, rubric-based feedback, candidate assistance, AI-generated recommendations, and user-facing guidance.

3) Build and Modernize Test Automation

• Take ownership of automated frontend, API, integration, and end-to-end test coverage using Cypress, Playwright, Pytest, Postman/Newman, or equivalent tools.

• Create reliable automated regression suites for critical ARBI and Athena workflows, including authentication, permissions, candidate pipelines, analytics, notifications, integrations, and admin experiences.

• Integrate tests deeply into CI/CD pipelines so failures are visible, actionable, and tied to release confidence.

• Improve test reliability, execution speed, data setup, fixture management, and maintainability.

• Introduce AI-assisted testing practices where useful, while maintaining clear human judgment and repeatable test evidence.

4) Validate Backend, API, Data, and Workflow Reliability

• Test robust REST APIs, Python/FastAPI services, backend business logic, asynchronous workflows, and data-processing pipelines.

• Validate PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch, Celery, Temporal, containerized services, deployment pipelines, and AWS-hosted environments from a QA perspective.

• Create API and integration test coverage for imports, exports, webhooks, permissions, search, scoring, candidate data, customer-specific configuration, and workflow automation.

• Test with realistic and large-scale datasets to uncover performance, latency, search relevance, data integrity, and resilience issues.

• Establish baseline performance, load, and reliability testing using JMeter, k6, Locust, or similar tools.

5) QA AI, LLM, and Evaluation Workflows

• Validate AI-assisted recruiting workflows for accuracy, consistency, explainability, hallucination risk, bias risk, prompt adherence, rubric alignment, and human-in-the-loop behavior.

• Test AI scoring, candidate summaries, recommendations, interview feedback, resume analysis, and knowledge-retrieval experiences across normal, adversarial, and edge-case inputs.

• Create repeatable evaluation datasets and test harnesses to measure AI quality over time.

• Validate guardrails, fallback behavior, citations, confidence indicators, data boundaries, audit trails, and customer-specific configuration.

• Partner with product and engineering to define what “good” means for AI-generated outputs and how release readiness should be measured.

6) Own Release Readiness and Quality Visibility

• Create clear, structured, reproducible bug reports with screenshots/videos, environment details, severity, expected behavior, actual behavior, impact, and reproduction steps.

• Retest fixed issues, validate root-cause resolution, and prevent regressions.

• Communicate QA status clearly before release: passed, failed, blocked, passed with known issues, or requires founder/product decision.

• Build dashboards and reporting for test coverage, defect trends, regression health, release risk, performance baselines, and customer-impacting quality issues.

• Help developers produce testable, high-quality code by establishing testing standards, review practices, and shared quality expectations.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

• A clear QA audit, quality strategy, and implementation roadmap are delivered and accepted by engineering and product leadership.

• A comprehensive ARBI and Athena test case portfolio exists across critical user journeys, backend services, data workflows, AI behavior, integrations, and release gates.

• Automated test coverage increases meaningfully across the highest-risk frontend, API, integration, and regression areas.

• CI/CD quality gates are established so test results directly inform release decisions.

• Baseline performance, load, security-oriented, and resilience testing practices are introduced for critical workflows.

• Release readiness becomes transparent, repeatable, and trusted by founders, engineering, product, customer success, and customers.

• You become the central authority for product quality and a mentor to developers on testing best practices.

Qualifications (Required)

• Experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Software Test Engineering, or a related product-quality role.

• Experience testing SaaS web products, B2B platforms, workflow systems, data-heavy applications, or AI-enabled products.

• Strong manual QA skills: exploratory testing, edge-case discovery, cross-browser validation, responsive web testing, clear bug reporting, and release sign-off.

• Hands-on automated testing experience with Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, Pytest, Postman/Newman, RESTAssured, or similar tools.

• Strong backend engineering fluency, especially with Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch, Celery, Temporal, containers, AWS services, and deployment pipelines.

• Experience validating large-scale datasets, data pipelines, integrations, asynchronous workflows, search/indexing behavior, and workflow automation.

• Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improving reliability, speed, observability, and developer feedback loops.

• Strong systems thinking, sound quality architecture judgment, and the ability to move from ambiguity to an executable QA roadmap.

• Ability to operate in startup-style environments with high ownership, speed, accountability, and mentoring responsibility.

• Ability and willingness to relocate to the Northern VA / Washington, DC area, or work closely with the team during Eastern Time business hours if remote.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience as a Staff QA Engineer, Lead QA Engineer, Quality Engineering Lead, SDET Lead, Founding QA Engineer, or QA Architect.

• Experience testing AI/LLM products, evaluation workflows, RAG systems, AI copilots, agentic workflows, or human-in-the-loop decision systems.

• Experience in HR tech, recruiting platforms, ATS/CRM systems, career services, assessment platforms, or workforce development products.

• Experience with A/B testing, feature flags, analytics validation, event tracking, access control, subscription/billing flows, or customer-specific configurations.

• Experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter, k6, Locust, or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with security, privacy, accessibility, SOC 2-style controls, federal deployment expectations, or auditability requirements.

• Comfort working directly with founders, customers, customer success, and implementation teams to translate real-world feedback into quality improvements.

Current / Target Tech Environment

• Frontend: ReactJS / modern web application interfaces.

• Backend: Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch, Celery, Temporal, and asynchronous workflow services.

• Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, containers, CI/CD pipelines, observability tooling, and production SaaS deployment practices.

• Testing: Cypress / Playwright-style E2E testing, API testing, integration testing, regression suites, performance testing, and AI-assisted QA workflows.

Compensation & Benefits

• Base Salary: Competitive and commensurate with experience, seniority, location, and ability to own quality across the product.

• Performance / Equity: Potential performance incentives and/or equity participation based on final offer structure.

• Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, PTO, and company-supported professional growth.

• Learning: Support for relevant courses, conferences, certifications, technical books, and quality engineering communities.

• Flexibility: Remote-first / hybrid flexibility with strong preference for Northern VA / DC-area alignment and occasional in-person collaboration.

Equal Opportunity

Neuroscale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description: This role may require in-person interview/s in Austin, Texas About Osano : Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape. About The Role: We're looking for a product-minded Senior Software Engineer to own meaningful parts of the Osano platform end to end, from shaping a problem with Product to running the result in production. This role is for an engineer who treats AI tooling as a real force multiplier. You use coding agents and AI-assisted workflows to explore unfamiliar code faster, ship more and remove repetitive work. You also have the judgment to verify everything that goes out under your name. We want someone whose impact goes beyond what they write by hand, and who helps the engineers around them do the same. You'll work across our React front end, Node.js services, PostgreSQL data stores and AWS infrastructure. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, QA and Security. This is a remote role. You must be based in, and authorized to work in, the United States. What you'll do: Build and ship product, end to end Lead multi-sprint projects from design through rollout: turn a loosely defined problem into a plan, break it into work that you and others can action, and deliver close to estimate. Design systems that hold up, and write design docs and decision records that weigh the alternatives. Partner with Product on scope: propose MVP cuts, phasing and tradeoffs, and measure whether what we shipped actually helped customers. Engineer with AI to multiply your impact Use AI coding agents and assistants across the whole development lifecycle: exploring codebases, scaffolding, writing tests, debugging, refactoring, migrations and code review. Stay accountable for every line you ship. You understand and can explain AI-generated code, and you know where AI shouldn't be trusted. Turn repetitive engineering work into automation: scripts, agent workflows, and checks that save your team time every week. Customer and personal data stays out of AI tools except through approved, privacy-safe paths. This is non-negotiable at a privacy company. Own what you ship in production Build observability, feature flags and rollback paths into your work from the start. Take turns on our triage and on-call rotation. Lead incident response for your team's systems, and see postmortem follow-ups through to completion. Identify tech debt, size it, and make the case to get it into the plan. Build with privacy and security by design Apply data minimization, residency, retention and access controls to the systems you design, especially those that handle customer and personal data. Write secure code and fix vulnerabilities in your area as part of normal work. Raise the bar and grow others Give code and design reviews that change outcomes, not just approvals. Mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and make your team better at testing, reviewing and operating software. Interview candidates and help us hire well. About you: Delightful Experience. You care about the customer problem, not just the ticket, and you push for what actually helps. Own Your Impact. You take full responsibility for outcomes, from the first design doc to how the feature behaves in production at 2 a.m. Stronger Together. You put team success ahead of individual wins, give direct and kind feedback, and treat documentation and async communication as first-class work. Growth Mindset. You're curious and keep learning, especially as AI changes how software gets built. You're excited about what it can do without overselling it or ignoring its limits. You're comfortable with ambiguity and create clarity for others through good design and clear writing. Must-haves: Typically 5+ years building and shipping production software. We care more about what you've owned than the number of years. A track record of leading multi-sprint projects from design to production in a team setting. Strong JavaScript/Node.js and React experience, and solid relational database skills (PostgreSQL preferred). Strong system design fundamentals: data modeling, API design, and naming the tradeoffs. Experience owning production systems : on-call, incident response, observability. Hands-on, day-to-day use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, with concrete examples of how they made you or your team more effective, and how you verify their output. Experience mentoring other engineers. Strong written communication in a remote, async environment. Nice-to-haves: AWS experience (ECS/Fargate, Lambda, S3, RDS), especially multi-region or data-residency work. Privacy, security or compliance-sensitive B2B SaaS (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2). Building AI-powered automations, agent workflows or LLM-based product features. Data and analytics tooling (Redshift, Athena) or event-driven architectures. CI/CD, preview/ephemeral environments, end-to-end testing (Cypress). How we work: Fully remote, with at least four hours of overlap each day with your team's core hours. Collaborative and video-on for meetings, and async-first for everything else. Bring people in when they are needed and share what you’re working on with the team. Regular 1:1 checkins with your manager, with a focus on growth conversations. Why Us: We're a welcoming team that's dependable, curious, moves fast, and full of talented people We're a B-corporation with a mission that matters, in a high-growth space with significant potential You'll have access to our training program, well-defined career paths, and a leadership team that values professional development Benefits: Competitive-pay compensation and ownership interest/equity Unlimited paid time off, plus a requirement to take at least two weeks off per year We're a Best Place for Working Parents and offer paid parental leave for all new parents Osano sponsors individual premiums on base plans at 100% and dependent premiums at 50% for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance via Aetna A fully and permanently remote company, so you can work from anywhere in the U.S. Receive a MacBook and $600 to craft your home workspace Annual company trip designed to foster connection, creativity, and fun Mental health benefits with free memberships to mindfulness and talk therapy services A Bit More About Osano: Osano is a leading data privacy platform that helps organizations quickly and confidently comply with laws like GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy regulations. From consent management to vendor risk monitoring, Osano makes complex privacy tasks refreshingly simple, so companies can focus on what they do best, while we handle the rest. We’re backed by top-tier investors, including Baird Capital, Jump Capital, and LiveOak, and we’re scaling fast with a multi-year runway and ambitious growth plans. We’ve also been recognized as a Great Place to Work for four years running, with 97% of employees saying Osano is a great place to work. Osano is an Equal Opportunity Employer.   • We're a Best Place for Working Parents and offer paid parental leave for all new parents

  • A fully and permanently remote company, so you can work from anywhere in the U.S.

title: Senior Reliability Engineer
description: About Halter At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures . To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram . About the role We’re changing the way the world farms - and with that comes a responsibility to the producers worldwide who trust us with their animals. Halter collars aren’t serviced, aren’t repairable and need to last 6-10 years, anywhere across the globe. We can’t wait a decade to find out whether a design will survive - so we have to know before it ships. That’s the job of our Reliability team. As a Reliability Engineer, you’ll be the person who turns “it needs to last” into evidence. You’ll own reliability for products and subsystems through development: assessing risk early, designing accelerated tests grounded in physics of failure, building the models that link hours in a chamber to years on a cow, and making a clear, evidence-backed call on whether a design is ready. You’ll close the loop with the field, comparing what fails out there with what our testing predicted, and changing our tests where they missed. What you’ll do Own the reliability plan for a product or major subsystem through development - turning reliability goals into measurable requirements, test plans and acceptance criteria Lead risk assessments, including failure mode and effects analysis and fault tree analysis, and review designs for robustness alongside mechanical, electrical and firmware engineers Design and run accelerated tests, including highly accelerated life testing and accelerated life testing, built from first principles and physics of failure, with clear learning goals and decision criteria Build reliability and acceleration models that link test time to field life, and write scripts and tools to automate repeated data analysis Correlate field failures with test results - show where our testing caught a failure mode, flag where it didn’t, and develop new test methods to replicate the field stresses we’re missing Write reliability reports and sign-off recommendations that others can audit, with residual risk and the evidence behind it made clear Assess the reliability impact of design, component, production and supplier changes, and work with suppliers on component qualification Improve our lab capability - evaluating and introducing new test equipment, fixtures and methods, and scoping and reviewing work from external labs Mentor and support junior engineers, reviewing their test setups and data and explaining the reasoning behind our methods This is a hands-on, first-principles role. We're looking for someone with real experience in reliability or hardware test engineering who wants to go deep on the craft - and who will hold the line on an unwelcome conclusion when the evidence supports it. We’re open on level and will work out the right fit through the interview process, from an experienced individual contributor through to someone ready to set technical direction for the team. What you’ll bring Several years of experience in reliability, test or hardware engineering on electronic or electromechanical products - a degree in electrical, mechanical, mechatronics or materials engineering, or similar, is preferred Hands-on experience designing and running reliability tests, such as accelerated life testing, highly accelerated life testing, or environmental and mechanical stress testing A solid understanding of how electronic products fail - for example solder joint fatigue, corrosion, moisture ingress, battery degradation and connector wear - and the physics that drives them Confidence with reliability statistics and modelling, such as life data analysis, acceleration models, confidence levels and sample sizing A first-principles mindset - you want to understand why a test represents the field, not just that it follows a standard Clear, honest communication grounded in evidence. You can explain risk and uncertainty to people outside your discipline, and you’ll hold your ground on an unwelcome conclusion when the data backs it Strong sense of ownership and a bias for action - you see what needs doing and get on with it without waiting to be asked A tenacious curiosity to figure things out, and the process discipline to do it properly every time Low ego, highly collaborative and willing to play for the front of the Jersey. Join our team Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. raw.jobDescription:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

We’re changing the way the world farms - and with that comes a responsibility to the producers worldwide who trust us with their animals. Halter collars aren’t serviced, aren’t repairable and need to last 6-10 years, anywhere across the globe. We can’t wait a decade to find out whether a design will survive - so we have to know before it ships. That’s the job of our Reliability team.

As a Reliability Engineer, you’ll be the person who turns “it needs to last” into evidence. You’ll own reliability for products and subsystems through development: assessing risk early, designing accelerated tests grounded in physics of failure, building the models that link hours in a chamber to years on a cow, and making a clear, evidence-backed call on whether a design is ready. You’ll close the loop with the field, comparing what fails out there with what our testing predicted, and changing our tests where they missed.

What you’ll do

  • Own the reliability plan for a product or major subsystem through development - turning reliability goals into measurable requirements, test plans and acceptance criteria

  • Lead risk assessments, including failure mode and effects analysis and fault tree analysis, and review designs for robustness alongside mechanical, electrical and firmware engineers

  • Design and run accelerated tests, including highly accelerated life testing and accelerated life testing, built from first principles and physics of failure, with clear learning goals and decision criteria

  • Build reliability and acceleration models that link test time to field life, and write scripts and tools to automate repeated data analysis

  • Correlate field failures with test results - show where our testing caught a failure mode, flag where it didn’t, and develop new test methods to replicate the field stresses we’re missing

  • Write reliability reports and sign-off recommendations that others can audit, with residual risk and the evidence behind it made clear

  • Assess the reliability impact of design, component, production and supplier changes, and work with suppliers on component qualification

  • Improve our lab capability - evaluating and introducing new test equipment, fixtures and methods, and scoping and reviewing work from external labs

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, reviewing their test setups and data and explaining the reasoning behind our methods

This is a hands-on, first-principles role. We're looking for someone with real experience in reliability or hardware test engineering who wants to go deep on the craft - and who will hold the line on an unwelcome conclusion when the evidence supports it. We’re open on level and will work out the right fit through the interview process, from an experienced individual contributor through to someone ready to set technical direction for the team.

What you’ll bring

  • Several years of experience in reliability, test or hardware engineering on electronic or electromechanical products - a degree in electrical, mechanical, mechatronics or materials engineering, or similar, is preferred

  • Hands-on experience designing and running reliability tests, such as accelerated life testing, highly accelerated life testing, or environmental and mechanical stress testing

  • A solid understanding of how electronic products fail - for example solder joint fatigue, corrosion, moisture ingress, battery degradation and connector wear - and the physics that drives them

  • Confidence with reliability statistics and modelling, such as life data analysis, acceleration models, confidence levels and sample sizing

  • A first-principles mindset - you want to understand why a test represents the field, not just that it follows a standard

  • Clear, honest communication grounded in evidence. You can explain risk and uncertainty to people outside your discipline, and you’ll hold your ground on an unwelcome conclusion when the data backs it

  • Strong sense of ownership and a bias for action - you see what needs doing and get on with it without waiting to be asked

  • A tenacious curiosity to figure things out, and the process discipline to do it properly every time

  • Low ego, highly collaborative and willing to play for the front of the Jersey.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. Location: Poland, Remote
Employment Type: Full-time, B2B Contract
Compensation: PLN 12,000–22,000 net + VAT per month

About PubNub

PubNub powers real-time interactive experiences that drive engagement, retention, and monetization. Our market-leading platform for real-time interactive apps enables customers to efficiently and effectively build, manage, and optimize engaging apps that captivate and delight users.

Founded in 2012, PubNub is backed by notable investors like The Raine Group, Sapphire, Scale, Relay, Cisco, Bosch, Ericsson, and HPE. To date, over 2,000 companies worldwide, including Amazon, RingCentral, Gameloft, and DAZN, choose PubNub to build and enhance large-scale apps that launch quickly to engage, monetize, and retain users.

At PubNub, you’ll enjoy the freedom of a remote-first environment paired with a collaborative culture designed to support your unique work style, so you can do your best work.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior GTM Engineer to build the AI-powered tools, automations, and integrations that help PubNub's go-to-market teams operate more effectively.

This is a hands-on engineering role combining software development, AI agents, automation, and business systems integration. You'll work across Marketing, Growth, Sales, and Customer Success, translating operational challenges into reliable technical solutions.

You'll take ownership of projects from discovery and prototyping through production deployment, helping teams reduce repetitive work, improve data quality, accelerate execution, and make better-informed decisions.

Success means delivering production-ready tools and automations that are adopted by teams and create measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain AI-powered tools, agents, and workflow automations for go-to-market functions.
  • Develop internal applications and integrations that improve prospecting, account research, lead enrichment, campaign execution, and customer intelligence.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand workflows, identify bottlenecks, and prioritise engineering opportunities.
  • Build and maintain integrations with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and other business systems.
  • Develop and maintain web-based applications and website infrastructure that support Marketing and Growth initiatives.
  • Use LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, and agent-based development workflows to accelerate engineering productivity.
  • Ensure solutions are maintainable, reliable, secure, and suitable for production use.
  • Measure tool adoption, operational efficiency, and business outcomes, iterating based on stakeholder feedback.

About You

Minimum Requirements

  • Strong professional software engineering experience, ideally involving full-stack development, internal tools, automation, or growth engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and modern web frameworks such as React or Next.js.
  • Strong experience working with APIs, system integrations, and data-driven applications.
  • Practical experience building AI-powered applications, agents, or automations using LLM APIs.
  • Experience taking applications from prototype to production, including testing, deployment, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to understand business problems and independently translate requirements into working technical solutions.
  • Strong ownership, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strong English communication skills and the ability to work with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating Salesforce, marketing automation, or revenue operations platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor.
  • Experience maintaining CMS-driven websites or marketing technology.
  • Familiarity with developer-focused SaaS products, API platforms, or agent-based workflows.
  • Experience developing reusable internal AI tools or agent skills.

Why PubNub

At PubNub, you'll help power real-time experiences used by millions around the world. What sets us apart is our people-first culture and strong sense of collaboration. Our team values the opportunity to contribute meaningfully, grow their skills, and help build innovative, high-impact technology.

We offer competitive B2B compensation and the flexibility of a remote-first environment. We're committed to fostering collaboration, professional growth, and opportunities to make a meaningful impact.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, own meaningful projects end to end, and work closely with teams that directly benefit from your engineering contributions.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're excited about building real-world AI solutions, automating complex workflows, and applying engineering to business challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

Join us and help shape how PubNub uses AI and automation across its go-to-market operations.

About ElevenLabs

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to make building with ElevenLabs easier, from a developer's first API key to a successful production integration.

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

title: Senior Software Engineer — AI-Native Engineering (XTM Foundation)
description: 🌀 The Company Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action. At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative. As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is genuinely, deeply convinced that AI is transforming the way software gets built, and who wants to make that transformation happen at Filigran. We are looking for an engineer first. This isn't a "we bought Copilot, please roll it out" role, and it isn't only a tooling or development role either: part of the job is building, part of it is trying things on real work, measuring them and telling teams honestly what works and what doesn't. This is a practitioner role for someone who has already lived this shift, who experiments constantly, who knows what works and what doesn't, and who can bring 60 engineers along on that journey. You will join the XTM Foundation team as Filigran's internal reference on AI-Native engineering. You'll propose our approach, build our practices, run experiments, and share the results so that teams can change how they work with confidence. You'll be hands-on, opinionated, and always one step ahead. 💼 Your Responsibilities Define and own Filigran's AI-Native engineering strategy: which tools, which workflows, which practices, and how they evolve as the landscape moves fast. Run structured experiments to evaluate new AI coding tools and agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline, MCP servers, code generation agents…), measure their real impact on velocity and quality, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Build the guardrails and engineering standards that ensure AI-generated code is maintainable, tested, and consistent with our quality bar — not just fast to produce. Work directly with product engineering teams (~80 engineers) to embed AI practices into their day-to-day workflows: pair programming with AI, AI-assisted code review, test generation, documentation, and beyond. Share what you learn. Run internal talks, workshops, and demos. Be the person engineers come to when they want to understand what's possible, and what isn't. Show real results, including the failures. Stay permanently ahead of the curve — the AI tooling landscape moves weekly. You'll be the one tracking it, filtering the noise, and surfacing what actually matters for a team like ours. Work in the XTM Foundation team to turn AI practices into shared building blocks for every product team: agent workflows in our CI pipelines (dependency updates, flaky test triage, review assistance), shared MCP servers and prompt libraries, versioned AI configuration in the repositories, and written rules on tools and data handling that apply to everyone. Contribute to Filigran's external voice on AI-Native engineering — blog posts, open-source contributions, conference talks — as the opportunity arises. 🤝 Who You'll Work With Reports to: Principal Engineer of XTM Foundation team. Key collaborators: Engineers and Engineering Managers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, and OpenGRC product teams; VP of Technology; CTO. Working model: You will split your time between XTM Foundation team work (research, experimentation, standards) and direct collaboration with product teams to embed AI practices in real engineering workflows. 🧬 Profile We're Looking For 7+ years of software engineering experience — you are a strong engineer first. You understand what good code looks like, and that's what makes your judgment on AI credible. You are genuinely AI-first in how you work. Not as a trend, not as a productivity hack. You've already transformed how you build software, you can show what you built and what you measured, and you want to help others do the same. Proven experience deploying AI-assisted development practices within an engineering team: you've done this before, you know what resistance looks like, and you know what actually works and what doesn't. Deep, hands-on familiarity with the current AI coding tooling landscape: agentic coding tools, LLM-powered code review, prompt engineering for development workflows, MCP ecosystems, and what's coming next. Strong full-stack engineering background — you can evaluate AI output across the whole stack and contribute code yourself when it matters. You can make a clear case, with evidence. You're a natural communicator who can discuss a trade-off with a skeptical senior engineer just as well as you can help a junior developer get started. Comfortable working in a remote-first, async culture with teams across multiple time zones; clear communicator in English. Autonomy and ownership mindset: you drive this agenda without waiting for direction, and you bring others with you rather than working alone. Bonus: experience with open-source communities, cybersecurity domain knowledge, contributions to AI tooling projects, or public writing/speaking on AI-Native engineering. 🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job. We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company , and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation . You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem. ⭐ Be part of something bigger We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative. 💻 Work at the edge of what’s next We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice. 🌍 Global opportunity without borders Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us. 🧭 A culture grounded in CORE Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching. 💰 What you can expect Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen 🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture. At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status. What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify. 🚀 Ready to Join Us? Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Strategic Accounts
description: Company Overview Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models. AI-First by Default At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
